def _calibrate(panel):
    (u, v) = (panel['u'], panel['v'])
    nxt = np.roll(u, -1, axis=1)
    basis = [np.column_stack((np.ones(len(u)), x, z, x * z, x ** 3)) for (x, z) in zip(u.T, nxt.T)]
    ids = np.arange(len(u))
    for _ in range(8):
        coef = np.column_stack([np.linalg.lstsq(f[ids], v[ids, j], rcond=None)[0] for (j, f) in enumerate(basis)])
        residual = np.column_stack([f @ coef[:, j] for (j, f) in enumerate(basis)]) - v
        ids = np.argsort(np.linalg.norm(residual, axis=1))[:len(u) - 3]
    return coef
